Heather Hadwick is a Republican member of the California State Assembly representing District 1. She was first elected in 2022 and is currently serving her second term, which is scheduled to end in 2026. She serves the communities of Redding, Anderson, and Shasta Lake in Shasta County.

Hadwick worked as a small business owner and real estate professional before entering elected office. She holds a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from California State University, Chico. Her professional background includes experience in business management and community economic development.

Hadwick has served on the Shasta County Board of Education and has been involved with local nonprofit organizations focused on education and workforce development. She has participated in community outreach programs related to small business support and youth services in the Shasta County region.

Hadwick resides in Redding, California, with her family. She is a native of Northern California and has been active in local civic organizations throughout her adult life, including serving as a mentor for young entrepreneurs and participating in regional economic development initiatives.

Matt Haney represents California State Assembly District 17 as a Democrat. He was first elected in 2018 and has served three terms through 2022. His current term expires in November 2024. He is the first openly gay person to represent San Francisco in the California State Assembly.

Haney earned a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from the University of California, Berkeley. Before elected office, he worked as a nonprofit executive at the San Francisco Education Fund, where he focused on education equity and school improvement. He also served as a legislative aide in the California State Assembly.

Haney has served on the San Francisco Board of Education, winning election in 2014 and re-election in 2016. He co-founded the San Francisco Education Fund in 2008, serving as its executive director until his election to the Assembly. He resides in San Francisco with his spouse.

Haney is fluent in Spanish. He has participated in civic organizations focused on affordable housing and immigrant rights. He was recognized by the San Francisco Chronicle as a rising political figure in the Bay Area.

Rodriguez earned a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from California State University, Los Angeles. Before entering elected office, she worked as a legislative aide in the California State Assembly. She also served as a community organizer with local nonprofit groups focused on education and immigration rights.

Rodriguez has prior elected experience on the Los Angeles Community College Board, where she served from 2014 to 2018. She is a founding board member of the East LA Youth Coalition, established in 2010. She resides in Los Angeles with her spouse and two children. She is fluent in Spanish and English.

Rodriguez was born in East Los Angeles. She is a first-generation college graduate. She participates annually in the Los Angeles County Latino Heritage Month celebration. She speaks Spanish at home and in her legislative office.

Angelique V. Ashby represents California State Senate District 8 as a Democrat. She was first elected to the State Senate in 2020 and is currently serving her second term, which expires in November 2024. Her district encompasses the Sacramento County communities of Elk Grove, Rancho Cordova, and portions of Sacramento.

Ashby earned a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from California State University, Sacramento. Before her election to the State Senate, she served as a legislative aide in the California State Assembly and held roles in nonprofit advocacy focused on education and workforce development. She also served on the Elk Grove Unified School District Board of Education from 2012 to 2018.

Ashby resides in Sacramento, California, with her family. She is the first Democrat to represent Senate District 8 since its boundaries were redrawn in the 2020 redistricting cycle. Her legislative priorities include education affordability, small business support, and expanding access to healthcare services in the Sacramento region.
